sql: SELECT audit_id, ts_utc, artifact_id, event_type, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.EventId') AS event_id, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Channel') AS channel, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') AS executable_info, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.MapDescription') AS map_description FROM unified_events WHERE case_id = ? AND artifact_id = 'evtx' AND COALESCE(CAST(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.EventId') AS INTEGER), -1) != 15 AND (payload_json ILIKE '%dpapi::masterkey%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%eo.oe.kiwi%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%event::clear%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%event::drop%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%gentilkiwi.com%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%kerberos::golden%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%kerberos::ptc%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%kerberos::ptt%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%kerberos::tgt%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%Kiwi Legit Printer%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%lsadump::%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%mimidrv.sys%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%mimilib.dll%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%misc::printnightmare%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%misc::shadowcopies%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%misc::skeleton%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%privilege::backup%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%privilege::debug%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%privilege::driver%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%sekurlsa::%')
